title: Pages
hint: Enter / click: open · M-t: tab · M-w: window

items.desc: browser → Emacs (the sending UI; the reference implementation)
Emacs → browser (the receiving UI; the reference implementation)
CodeMirror viewer (shows a text, read-only; code_editor edits)
CodeMirror file editor (code.html + the keymap of code.json editorKeymap, vim by default + saving + kill-ring)
two saved files side by side, read only (a skin's diff -n A,B / diff -f A,B / :Diff; ?a=&b=). Reads both again when one is said to have changed
the points kept of a file as a tree (a skin's juncture tree; ?path=): Enter puts one into the code_editor unsaved, d diffs it with the file on disk, o opens it (D-juncture)

a note drawn, read only (a skin's markdown <path>; ?path=): the saved text, or -- markdown follow / f -- the unsaved text and cursor of the code_editor of the skin that has it. Raw HTML stays text, images are not shown

a note's table (Table: <name>) edited as a table: the matrix grid, and i edit, o / O add a sibling / child row, d d, J / K, w to its book (~work/books), W into the note (a skin's task_table take <path> <name>; ?path=&table=)

a book of lines sent one by one, the smallest id with an empty status first, each to its input (input_target): R run, S stop, i edit, o a row, x its status emptied, d d (a skin's run new <template>; ?template=&book=)
an output_log's record set beside a run_table's book, row by row: the key the record has, its line, ≠ where they differ; Enter the row's lines (a skin's run match <record> [<book>]; ?log=&book=)

an answer of Emacs made a table: the intents with a result.table answer here (from the input panel). Enter opens the row's file, the intent's keys run intents with the row's values, r asks again (?intent=<id>: that one only)
the skins kept by skin save: lines (empty ones), axis, ratios, panels; a panel kept under an old name is marked. Enter opens one in a new frame window, M-r reads it into the frame focused last
a small vim editor with no file: a sentence written, then :m sends it (:m input / :m xterm / :m code_editor <file> / :m back to who asked); :q drops it (a skin's minimum [purpose])
file tree (reads /fs; Enter=code.open, o=a new code_editor window)
transcript of extension (intent) runs (the Elisp as unsent, with live status)
the file tree's bookmarks (m in tree adds one)

the task list: the rows a task_table cut (L), in its order. t the next state, d DONE, x CANCELLED (and every task under it), M-n a new task, Enter its line in the note. Changes go to the task_table's book (D-task-list)
session services (kill-ring / cursor). Bundled in main.html; also runs alone (a singleton)
dialogue bridge, the driving side (Proof General etc.)
dialogue bridge, the observing side (goals/response)
PTY terminal (xterm.js; not through vent)
receive-only mirror for compile.run (?source=the xterm window's bus id; empty when opened alone)
the Claude Code CLI in a PTY pane of its own (xterm.html ?cmd= / ?size=15; the font is the terminal's own, config.json ui.terminal.fontFamily)
the Codex CLI in a PTY pane of its own (same as claude: xterm.html ?cmd= / ?size=15; codex must be on the relay's PATH)
the relay's ledger of connections (GET/DELETE /windows)
the database windows (GET /sql/windows: number, account, database, state); Del logs one out. In the dock, at the bottom: db list open / close
the language servers running (GET/DELETE /lsp/servers; Del stops one)
the diagnostics of the code_editor open now (Enter goes to the place)
Xipe Totec's functions (card/list: file:line, effect, calc rows). Enter opens the card in matrix.html, M-d the definition in a code_editor
the table (matrix.html): a grid of what an adapter fetched (?kind=&ref=&root=), sorted, filtered, coloured, CSV. Driven by a matrix_bar in the synthesis matrix_set
a command line: Mod-Enter posts what it holds (cmd.input) to the main of its synthesis or skin; alone it reaches nobody
the main of the synthesis matrix_set (D-synthesis): which table is shown, matrix update / get / pwd and radar from its command line to its table

the main of the synthesis database (D-db-session): the window's number, account@host:port/database, its state, the masked password field; the relay's /sql socket, statements from its command line, answers to its table
the definitions of the code_editor used last in the same skin (the syntax tree, else lsp's documentSymbol; Enter goes there)
the record of LSP operations of the code_editor in the same skin (definition, references, rename, format, hover). Enter goes to the place; lsp.back / lsp.forward go by it
what is running and what ran: the bus's start / end pairs (work.json), kept by the work store of a skin. Enter goes to who fired it, Del stops it
the work list, only what is still waited for (slow: longer than its pair allows)
every page of the launcher, as a list (Enter opens, M-t a tab, M-w a window) -- what main.html showed before it became the main skin
the tezcatl-command palette
pane/window navigator (the skin supplies its contents)
kill-ring picker (a skin opens it with Esc-y; empty when opened alone)
turns the colour it is given (color <colour> / color <JSON> <name>, the tezcatl command color.show)
one picture of the pages (image <path>, the tezcatl command image.show; ?path=, none: assets/tezcatlipoca.png), fitted to the panel
a US tenkeyless keyboard as ASCII: the keys the lead-key input form of the same skin sends (bus lead.keys) light up in five shades and step down every 2 s

the lead-key input form: type keys as ;c ;a ;h ;e ... (two lines: typed / what is sent), Enter sends through the input_target of the same skin; each key typed lights the virtual keyboard; ;: and the like run tezcatl commands

where the lead-key input form of the same skin sends (bus lead.send -> lead.sent): the destinations there now (input_target/: emacs-vent, the code_editor and xterm panels of the skin), one picked by its letter (e, t1 ...) or a click
where the receiving side of the same skin takes its lines from: tezcatl, emacs-vent, each xterm (a letter picks; recv.show -> recv.lines). Alone: the chosen record under the list
how to use the input form: its keys, the lead-key table and its shortcuts, the frame's lines -- from config.json ui.keys and command_map.json (a part of the dock)
the local time, as large as the box lets it be, and the date (a part of the dock)
suggestions: the next word of an input-form line, from suggestion/line.json (digits / Enter pick, hjkl ^ - move; ?in=frame,code_editor narrows)
suggestions: the intent ids of command/binding_map.json
suggestions: the words of the dictionary (dict.json, ?list= else default), at any place of the line
tells when the file of an open code_editor changes (a clean one reads it again). Put it in the same skin as code_editor
a trial skin (input and output side by side; the leave key opens nav)
a skin with input and the extension transcript (code_el_intent) side by side

the frame: panels stacked in 1 to 4 columns (A to D), arranged from the one-line input form below (skin main, sub, add, del, switch, focus, name, save, read). Starts empty; skin save keeps it as a new skin
the frame with its dock below (D-dock: dock side l|b|r turns it later)
the frame with its dock on the left (D-dock: dock side l|b|r turns it later)
the frame with its dock on the right (D-dock: dock side l|b|r turns it later)
in place of treemacs (the slot list + tree + code_editor + a command line. The slots are the FS root's tree.json; code_editor edits it)
a frame holding the synthesis matrix_set: the table + a command line (matrix update / get / pwd, radar). Xipe Totec's calc rows first
Xipe Totec's dialogue window (transcript + input + dictionary; holds one /xipe connection. ?root= is a name in xipe.json, default .)
